name: mayu wifey
greetingText: I really like your name btw!
wishText:
I don’t know when it happened—maybe it was the way you smiled, or the calm I feel when I think of you—but somehow, without asking, you became my favorite thought. You live quietly in my heart, yet everything feels louder, brighter, more alive because of you.

When I think of you, the world slows down. My worries fade, my fears soften, and all that’s left is this warm feeling that I can’t explain, only feel. You make ordinary moments feel special and lonely days feel hopeful. Even when we’re not together, a part of you stays with me, like a gentle promise that I’m not alone.

I love the way you are—not just the beautiful parts, but everything. Your thoughts, your emotions, your presence. You don’t even have to try; you just exist, and somehow that’s enough to make my heart choose you again and again.

If I could give you one thing, it would be the certainty of how deeply you matter to me. I would choose you on the quiet days, on the difficult days, and on every day in between. Loving you feels natural, like something my heart was waiting to do.

No matter where life takes us, I want you to know this: you are cherished, you are special, and you are deeply loved—by me.

Always yours,
Lucifer 💗
